purpose: Turn the selected static appearance into reusable pure-2D painting guidance and shot briefs across topics; describe targets without guaranteeing that a tool or model will achieve them.

reference.selection_scope: Style selection for static form, painting refinement, light/material treatment and visual hierarchy.
reference.primary_observation: The main image expresses structure through credible human proportions, clothing folds and equipment connections; warm lit edges, shadow color planes and prioritized detail establish refined 2D painted volume.
reference.supporting_observation: Small natural-environment thumbnails provide supporting clues for depth layering and light/dark space. The blue transparent-object thumbnail provides supporting clues for translucent edges and highlights; its resolution cannot support item-by-item structural or scientific-detail judgments.
exclude_from_style: Screenshot sidebars, thumbnail arrangement, blue selection box and white interface background
Making the reference's person, clothing colors, equipment, environmental species or transparent object mandatory for every topic
not_approved_by_reference: Any new image, character or object variant
Scientific structure, mechanism, scale, color meaning and causal relationships
Continuous action, timing, camera motion and audiovisual coordination
Whole-film quality, platform performance and publication

priority: The current shot's verified scientific objects, structures, conditions and expression boundaries
The explanation task, attention center and required spatial relationships
This file's 2D form, lighting, material and hierarchy language
Series color, annotation and layout parameters, adjusted to scientific color meanings and actual physical properties

medium.target: Refined, clear, painterly pure-2D illustration; painted volume, soft transitions, local brushwork and evidence-based translucent materials are allowed.
medium.construction: Establish silhouette proportions, structural connections and occlusion first, then finish forms with color planes, hard/soft edges, lighting and material differences. Two-dimensional does not mean only outlines and flat fills.
medium.tool_independence: Choose drawing tools, image-generation methods and file formats for the current task and actual capabilities. Tool names, resolution and prompts are not evidence of refinement.

shape_and_structure: The subject has recognizable, credible silhouette, turns, thickness variation and contact relationships. Necessary component connections, load bearing, attachment or force directions must make sense in the picture.

Detail follows object structure: organize folds around volume and forces, give seams/accessories plausible continuations, and avoid mechanical repetition in natural forms. Do not add such details when these objects are absent from the shot.

If people appear, establish credible proportions, hands and equipment relationships for the shot's specified age, build and action. Do not force a replica of the reference person or make every person the same character.

A mechanism layer may abstract nonessential detail for scientific purposes, while retaining the structures, relative positions and boundaries the explanation depends on. Simplification does not mean replacing objects with default icons.
light_and_value: Explain form through directional lighting, turns and shadow. Establish broad light/dark masses first; local highlights and shadows serve structure.

In contextually appropriate natural-light scenes, the reference's warm illumination and cooler environmental layers may continue. Adapt nighttime, artificial-light or special physical conditions to their actual situation rather than fixing all shots to golden sunlight.

Keep readable value/color-temperature separation at the subject focus and recognizable structure in shadows. Avoid a globally gray image, washed-out whites, highlights that erase detail or equal brightness for every object.
Form lighting must not impersonate scientific variables. Do not add glow, temperature gradients, concentration boundaries, energy beams or nonexistent shadow/projection relationships for beauty.
material: Distinguish materials through deformation, edges, highlight width, reflections and necessary surface information. Do not apply the same plastic highlight or uniform noise texture to different objects.
Attach detail and brushwork to object form, prioritizing focal areas, key contacts and material recognition. Do not impose a fixed texture/seam count per shot.

Use transparency/translucency only when allowed by object properties and explanatory scope. Translucent appearance cannot justify adding hollow walls, internal cloud patterns or mirrored surfaces, or claim a verified refracted-light path.
Decorative microtexture unrelated to the explanation may be omitted. Preserve clear structure and subject refinement instead of substituting dense texture for finishing.
edges: Use hard edges, soft edges and appropriately lost edges according to structure, focus and depth of field. Keep key subject contours and contacts clear; nonessential transitions may soften.
Vary line/brush weight with material and structure. Do not surround all natural objects or internal details with equal-color, equal-width outlines.

Give actual boundaries, cutaway boundaries and explanatory annotations distinct roles. Arrows/leaders cannot masquerade as physical structure, and a highlighted outer ring cannot replace subject form.
depth_and_composition: Establish space through scale, occlusion, value, color temperature and edge density together. Reduce contrast/detail density in distant views where appropriate rather than sharpening every distance equally.

Make the principal object and key relationship visible first. Supporting objects provide location, and background supports context. A refined background must not become the only finished area beside a rough subject.
Mechanism close-ups establish depth with verifiable structural layers and spatial anchors. Do not force sky, plants or realistic depth of field into them for style.
Negative space serves later action, observation paths, labels or captions. Set its extent and subject size by the shot's task rather than a fixed decorative border or empty backing plate.
color: Preserve a bright, clear overall relationship supported by a value range. Prioritize vivid colors rather than making every color area equally saturated.
The series palette supplies color roles, without forcing objects into fixed yellow, blue or green. Scientific identity colors, actual species features and variable legends take priority.
Keep each object's color identity trackable across wide, object and mechanism-close-up views. Control mechanism-variable color meaning separately from form lighting.

exclusions: Using rough sketches, stick figures or unrefined geometric assemblies directly as final subjects
Replacing the scientific object this shot needs viewers to recognize with default icons, emoji, sticker outlines or generic stock symbols
Uniform thick black outlines, equal-width internal lines and the same flat-fill hierarchy for every object
A detailed realistic background while the subject remains a placeholder with rough contours, wrong proportions or missing structural connections
Using light spots, particles, plants, textures, borders or flares to conceal unfinished contours, structure, materials or hierarchy
Interpreting pure 2D as prohibiting painted light/shadow and volume, or unilaterally replacing it with a plastic/clay-like 3D-rendered appearance
All materials sharing the same highlights, reflections, transparent shells or noise overlays
Mechanically copying the reference topic, person, pose, clothing colors and environment without rebuilding structure for the current object
Adding unsupported physical boundaries, anatomical parts, light paths, energy flows, particle states or action causality for beauty

brief_usage.template_state: Pending shot facts and production intent; not an already generated or reviewed image.
brief_usage.method: Fill input_fields for the current shot, then replace slots in the selected brief_templates. The result may directly guide drawing or supply an image-call prompt. Unreplaced slots cannot be treated as a complete brief.
brief_usage.scientific_unknowns: If evidence determining structure or mechanism is missing, state pending verification and obtain evidence first. Style templates, models and reference images cannot guess scientific facts.
brief_usage.action_layers: Motion-layer descriptions identify stable/moving content, occlusion and connection constraints required for production. A single image represents only its specified instant, cannot prove correct motion and does not guarantee automatic editable layers from an image tool.
brief_usage.text_policy: Text zones record position, purpose, exact copy and protected areas. If text cannot be generated reliably, preserve empty space and typeset separately instead of using gibberish placeholders or sacrificing subject space.
brief_usage.complexity_policy: Do not preset per-shot texture, line, light, object or brushstroke counts. Preserve necessary information according to scientific explanation, frame and actual viewing size.

input_fields.explanation_goal: The object relationship, change or judgment viewers should understand from this shot, not merely a topic name.
input_fields.frame_and_viewpoint: Frame and viewing dimensions, viewpoint, crop boundaries and shot size. Specify complete contours to retain and allowed details/crops.
input_fields.objects_and_structure: Object identity, necessary components, proportional evidence, structural connections, contact positions, spatial anchors and features that must persist across shots.
input_fields.action_layers: List stable and moving layers as actually needed: content, current state, action direction, fixed boundaries, attachment/occlusion and before/after states. For static shots, state the static observation objective.
input_fields.scientific_constraints: Verified conditions, scales and explanatory boundaries; identify schematic elements versus those requiring observational fidelity, with evidence locations.
input_fields.scientific_forbidden: Incorrect components, topology, boundaries, interactions, glow, particle states, light paths or action misconceptions this shot must not depict.
input_fields.materials_and_light: Actual object materials, usable form cues, contextual light direction and shadow organization. Explicitly exclude inapplicable transparency/texture.
input_fields.background: Purposeful environmental/mechanism background, supporting references, depth layers and information to suppress.
input_fields.negative_space: Positions and purposes reserved for later action, observation paths or explanation, consistent with subject size and actual frame.
input_fields.text_zones: Reserved caption/label/legend areas, exact copy or separate-typesetting instructions, and objects/contact areas that must remain unobstructed.
input_fields.color_semantics: Object identity, scientific-variable color meanings, legends and noncolor distinction cues. If no variables are color-encoded, state that colors serve form/material only.
input_fields.continuity_anchors: Corresponding object contours, components, directions, color identities, reference points and features that cannot change arbitrarily across adjacent shots.

whole_scene.role: Whole scene: establish the object's context, spatial relationships and attention center.
prompt_template: Paint a refined, clear pure-2D whole scene with painted volume. Reuse the reference's structural completion, material differentiation and prioritized edges without copying its person or topic.
Explanation goal: {{explanation_goal}}. Frame, viewpoint and shot size: {{frame_and_viewpoint}}.
Objects, necessary structure and spatial connections: {{objects_and_structure}}. Stable/moving layers and current state: {{action_layers}}.
Evidence and expression boundaries: {{scientific_constraints}}. Scientific prohibitions: {{scientific_forbidden}}.
Materials and contextual lighting: {{materials_and_light}}. Establish volume through subject silhouette, lit/shadow masses and contact first, then add necessary material treatment.

Environment and depth layers: {{background}}. Background supports object location. Differentiate distance through scale, occlusion, light/dark and edge density; subject refinement must be no lower than background refinement.
Negative-space purpose: {{negative_space}}. Text zones and protected areas: {{text_zones}}.
Scientific color meaning: {{color_semantics}}. Cross-shot anchors: {{continuity_anchors}}. Follow this file's exclusions. Decorative density cannot replace structure and hierarchy.
whole_scene.comparison_focus: At reduced size, the main object and key relationship remain locatable. Enlarged inspection shows consistent completion of structure, contact, materials and near/far edges.

object.role: Object view: make form, key components, materials and action-bearing areas identifiable.
prompt_template: Paint a refined pure-2D object view retaining its identity from the whole scene. Explain form through credible silhouette, structural turns, local occlusion and painted lighting.
Observation and explanation task: {{explanation_goal}}. Frame, viewpoint, crop and viewing scale: {{frame_and_viewpoint}}.
Components, proportions, connections and contacts that must be identifiable: {{objects_and_structure}}. Action layers, current pose and fixed boundaries: {{action_layers}}.
Scientific evidence and schematic boundaries: {{scientific_constraints}}. Prohibited content: {{scientific_forbidden}}.
Materials and lighting: {{materials_and_light}}. Edges, highlights, deformation and necessary textures serve their respective materials without uniform outlining or plastic highlights.
Background and locating references: {{background}}. Concentrate detail on structures/contacts needed for explanation. Let background recede appropriately while retaining the same 2D language.
Action/observation negative space: {{negative_space}}. Text zones: {{text_zones}}. Scientific color meaning: {{color_semantics}}.
Preserve cross-shot anchors: {{continuity_anchors}}. Follow this file's exclusions. Refine the object itself before considering decoration.
object.comparison_focus: Establish object silhouette, proportions and structural contact first. Materials are distinguishable, key components are recognizable at actual viewing size, and the object remains the same one as in the whole scene.

mechanism.role: Mechanism close-up: turn object structure and scientific relationships into a trackable two-dimensional explanation.
prompt_template: Paint a refined pure-2D mechanism close-up sharing form, color meanings and edge language with whole/object views. Simplify nonessential detail for the scientific task without reverting to default-icon collage.
Relationship or change to understand: {{explanation_goal}}. Frame, viewpoint, cutaway/detail extent and scale: {{frame_and_viewpoint}}.
Structure, topology, relative positions, contacts and spatial anchors that must be preserved: {{objects_and_structure}}.

Stable structure, moving content, current state, attachment and occlusion constraints: {{action_layers}}. A single image shows only this state; do not add an unspecified mixture of before/after states.
Scientific evidence, simplification and limits on extrapolation: {{scientific_constraints}}. Scientific prohibitions: {{scientific_forbidden}}.
Materials and form lighting: {{materials_and_light}}. Use light/dark and edges to reveal existing structures, without adding nonexistent boundaries, glow or physical variables through light effects.
Mechanism background and locating references: {{background}}. Do not force natural scenery into the image; distinguish cutaway/explanatory boundaries from actual physical boundaries.
Negative space for observation paths or later actions: {{negative_space}}. Label, legend and caption zones: {{text_zones}}.

Scientific color meanings and auxiliary recognition cues: {{color_semantics}}. Anchors corresponding to the object view: {{continuity_anchors}}. Follow this file's exclusions. Arrows, leaders and text must not replace structural relationships that need to be visible.
mechanism.comparison_focus: Structures and anchors map individually to the object view. Scientific relationships do not depend on decorative light effects or guessing from color alone. Abstract boundaries, physical boundaries and annotation roles are clear.

use_and_review_boundary: Default to this static style when producing candidate images, without treating style selection as a guarantee of tool capability for every call.
Check structure, scientific prohibitions, three-scale continuity and viewing size for each new shot's actual content. Using a reference does not automatically fill in a pass.
For motion, separately check trajectories, connection constraints, before/after states and audiovisual coordination. Static style references and still-frame checks do not replace continuous viewing.
If scientific accuracy conflicts with decoration, warm lighting, translucency or detail density, preserve accuracy and adjust art expression.
scope: Historical approved 2D appearance and requested illustration covers only. Realistic main footage uses its own applicable reference; these tokens do not prohibit Blender or impose illustration colors on scientific objects.
